mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which in turn increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2% and FEDFUNDS subsequently rise.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months indicates a tightening labor market, which leads to increased wage pressures and higher production costs, negatively impacting corporate profit margins and thus S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous 3 months signals increased demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases by more than 5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals a contraction in the supply side of the economy, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the previous 3 months signals a loosening monetary policy, which reduces borrowing costs and increases liquidity, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases over the previous 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% over the previous 3 months signals increased consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS increases by more than 2% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the previous 3 months signals a strengthening labor market, which increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase and UNRATE decrease in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases over the previous 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with an increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over the previous 6 months signals a stimulative monetary policy in a growing economy, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decrease and GDPC1 increase in 6 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases and GDPC1 increases over the previous 6 months.
